verdict.rationale: Persona can be driven headlessly through its REST API, including a backend-only Transactions API with no Persona UI, API pre-creation and polling of inquiries, and webhooks for status updates. For CI-style automated tests, sandbox mode, Simulate Actions for programmatic lifecycle testing, and force pass/fail toggles let you exercise integrations without real verifications. Missing for 10: no official CLI or explicit CI pipeline guidance, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
